Sheet Owner is already 'Western Concessions Private Ltd [100.%]' with no separate operating company anywhere in the record, so Operator = Owner here is the well-evidenced answer — unlike P0931 below, where a similarly-named but LEGALLY DISTINCT H-Energy group entity holds the authorization instead.
